newsitem.title: USA: Brazil may limit cash offers for global bond - leads. [CORRECTED 23:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil may limit cash offers for global bond - leads. [CORRECTED 23:25 GMT]

text.p: Brazil reserves the right to limit to $250 million the aggregate of all new cash offers in bids made by any one individual or institution for its upcoming 30-year global bond, according to a statement from joint managers Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan & Co Inc.
(Corrects to clarify that the $250 million possible cap refers to the total of bids from any one individual or institution, not to the total of all new cash offers received by Brazil.)
The $1.0 billion global bond is being issued as part of a Brazilian effort to swap or buy back Brady bonds. The offer will expire June 3 unless extended or ended earlier by Brazil.
Early price talk pegged the global at about 375 to 385 (corrects spread) basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
